`limit` is the length of the buffer this decoder was built from. Any element's content length is strictly smaller than that buffer, because the tag and length bytes are part of it. Nested decoders are created with ASN1Decoder.create(subarray), so their limit is the sub-array length, and the content is still smaller than that. A valid encoding is therefore never rejected by `length >= limit`.
